trans-unit.source: Translate automatically: Run Supertext AI translation whenever pages or content elements are localized.

Supertext API key: No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin . Generate your API key at supertext.com > Integrations > API (https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api, requires the Admin role). The environment variable SUPERTEXT_API_KEY takes precedence.
API environment
Custom API base URL: Overrides the environment when set (e.g. https://api.supertext.com/v1/).
Polling timeout (seconds): Maximum time to wait for a translation.
Polling interval (seconds)
Skip bodytext for these content types: Comma-separated CTypes whose bodytext is code, not prose.
Regenerate page slugs: Build the URL segment of a translated page from its translated title.
Nothing was translated.
Supertext translated %d field(s) in %d record(s) into %s.

No Supertext API key configured. Records were localized but not translated. No Supertext account yet? Create one at https://www.supertext.com/person/en/account/signin . Generate your API key at https://www.supertext.com/en/integrations/api (supertext.com → Integrations → API, requires the Admin role) and enter it in the extension configuration.
